_llm_instructions: قم بتعبئة 'project_title' و 'date_prepared'، بالإضافة إلى خصائص 'value' لكل حقل في نموذج تقرير المخاطر هذا بناءً على سياق المشروع. السياق والتعريف: [ أضف السياق والتعريف هنا ] المحاذاة: [ أضف معلومات المحاذاة هنا ]

Executive Summary.guidance: A statement describing the overall project risk exposure and major individual risks.

Overall Project Risk - Status and Trends.guidance: Provide a description of the overall risk of the project.

Overall Project Risk - Significant Drive.guidance: Identify the significant drivers of overall risk.

Individual Project Risks - Metrics.guidance: Number of scope, schedule, cost, and quality risks. High/Medium/Low distribution.

Individual Project Risks - Top Risks.guidance: The most critical risks and their planned responses.

Individual Project Risks - Changes.guidance: Changes to critical risks since the last report.

Quantitative Analysis Summary - Probabil.guidance: Probability of meeting scope, schedule, cost, quality objectives.

Quantitative Analysis Summary - Range of.guidance: Range of schedule and cost outcomes.

Quantitative Analysis Summary - Key Driv.guidance: Drivers of variance and proposed responses.

Reserve Status.guidance: Total Cost/Schedule Reserve, Used to Date, Used This Period, Remaining Reserve.

Risk Audit Summary.guidance: Summary of Risk Events, Risk Management Processes, and Recommendations.
